summary: The paper's §18 day walked in Rail Demo's window through the window's own doors, step by step as docs/ACCEPTANCE_1.0.md Part 4 says (Guide > Try Rail Demo > Build it; the project; the specification and a wire's basis; open it; ask her; Open beside; change a value and Save; her notice; the plan approved press by press; page and report verified; FINDINGS; close; restart and the journal). Once with the real 4B (Day 1920x1200, under the lock), then, after fixing what it showed, with the stand-in worker replaying the 4B's answers in day, night, graphite and kasandra at 1920x1200 and day at 1366x768: every walk ran steps 1-13 with no traceback. Fixes (each marked 1.0 X1): a review question answered from the desk's findings (the 4B had answered from memory); she notices a page and a report still carrying the old value and offers Update (new day_notice.py); a model plan that leaves out a requested change is not offered; the page's sentence gets its moved input too; Carry on never pushed off NEXT STEPS; Update not offered twice; RECHECK shown in FINDINGS; 'Last: ..., done. Its journal' under ACTIVE WORK; the Rail Demo door places K5's invented report so the report is updated through her hidden LibreOffice, read back and verified. The acceptance page was rewritten to match.

turns.outcome: answered from the model's memory, wrong claims ('I cannot review assembly files...')
turns.after_fix: no model turn: answered from the desk's findings
left out the page update, so the desk's plan is offered, with words saying so

real_4b.frames: overwritten by the later stand-in Day walk (harness slip); a second real run was not made (one short run). run_model.sh makes it in about 6 minutes.

decisions: Rail Demo through the Guide (demo_try.build) now also gets K5's invented report and power sheet (office_bridge.place_examples), so the day's 'previous report' exists and K5 updates it; rail_demo.workspace (tests, campaigns) is unchanged.

A review/sufficiency question is answered from the records only (findings with their states, open questions); 'sufficient' only when all are supported and nothing is open; her model is not asked for that verdict.
Her notice runs off the window's thread, only when the set of RECHECK calculations changes; Update only asks for the plan (offered, nothing runs).

A model plan missing a change step that the desk's plan of the same words has is not offered: the desk's plan is, with her words saying so (the 4B dropped the page update; 'done' would have hidden it).

Where the window and the page disagreed I fixed small faults in the window and rewrote the page's words for the rest (step 2's 'concern in the Desk drawer', step 3's Rev A, step 6 on a small screen, step 7's dialog, step 13's journal).
The real 4B was run once, as the brief allows; the fixes after it were walked with the stand-in replaying the 4B's own answers.
The walk opened Rail Demo's window itself with the environment the door gives (the door's detached start recorded, not run), and the restart likewise, rather than typing the command in Terminal.
findings_for_the_coordinator: Rail Demo's own workspace has no model: a model readied in Part 3 is not ready in Rail Demo (registration and selection live in the workspace). The page now says to Stop brain in the own window and Add file / Use model in Rail Demo's Brain room.
The report and the updated page are not recorded as outputs on the board (the page shows as a dashed 'possible' link, the .odt not at all).
At 1366x768 the board shows 3-4 neighbours in its upper half and groups the rest ('and 13 more'), leaving the lower half empty.
In the split, each Office pane's tool row, foot and status line are clipped at the pane's edge ('Previe', 'Ope').
The cabinet's project row (Concern > Unassigned > Questions > Rail Demo (invented data)) opens its old record page on a single click, not the board.
Her state word reads NEEDS YOUR WORD whenever the desk has a waiting card, with nothing in 'Waits for you'.
A synthetic double-click on the Office grid did not open its cell dialog under Xvfb (the walk called the grid's own handler): to be seen on the ThinkPad.
The seed must be made current after these files change (shell2.py among them): with a stale seed a finding's check says 'Graphite seed/source binding is not current'.
The real 4B's PLAN dropped a requested clause; with the 35B this may differ: the desk now refuses such a plan.
not_done: Frames of the real 4B walk (overwritten); no second real run after the fixes.
The optional HALT (photo 25) was not walked.
Step 13 was walked as a new process with the page's environment, not by typing the command in Terminal.
Nothing was tested in the owner's sense; nothing ran on the ThinkPad.
release_note: The day of the paper, in the window: on Rail Demo, Kasandra answers 'is it sufficient?' from the desk's findings (settled power supported, startup not cleared), notices by herself that the summary and the report still say the old value after you change a reading, and offers Update; the plan's changes wait for your word, her hidden LibreOffice updates the report and reads it back, and 'done' means verified. A plan from her model that leaves out something you asked for is not used. After a restart, the last task's journal is one press away under ACTIVE WORK.
